highlights:
## 🧩 Bring your app to Nod

Build a connector from an MCP server, an HTTP API or a CLI. The [contributor guide](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/contribute/apps/) and AI builder skill help you create an app folder, follow the standard and add the required tests. Then open a pull request for review. Approved connectors get an Apps entry, a public page and a social image.

Already have an MCP server on your computer or network? Enter its local or private address in **Apps → Connect MCP**.

## 👀 See Nod's last few steps

Select the activity line in chat or a task to see up to four recent operations, newest first. Close the list when you want a quieter view. It stays closed while the work continues.

## Also in this release

- **Bug reports:** **Report bug** is easier to find. Nod offers a report when something in Nod itself fails. You review what gets sent.
- **File previews:** Right-click an image in the preview panel to save or open it.
- **Memory:** Nod follows references in requests to remember earlier details. Notes you write keep their line breaks.
- **Sign-in:** MCP setup shows the service's reason when sign-in cannot start. ChatGPT sign-in works when its usual local port is busy.
- **Long chats:** Earlier tools stay available on later turns. Context errors no longer leave the chat stuck.
